title: Interview. Palantir, DLocal & the Psychology of Investing with Babylon Capital

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: An investor shares his views on Palantir, DLocal, and the psychology behind high-growth investing.
reader_summary.overview: This episode features an interview with Dimitry from Babylon Capital. They discuss his investment philosophy and how he found early opportunities in companies like Palantir and DLocal. The conversation also covers portfolio construction and the importance of understanding investor psychology.

key_points.text: The guest explains his approach to identifying quality businesses and gaining confidence in high-growth assumptions.
He discusses common investment mistakes and the need to understand one's own psychology.

reader_summary.why_it_matters: Listeners gain insight into how to think about high-growth stocks and manage their own investment psychology.
